# Master Services Agreement (Supplier draft)

This Agreement is made between Apex Systems Pvt Ltd ("Supplier") and Contoso Ltd ("Customer").

## 1. Term and termination
This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twelve (12) months. Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice.

## 2. Automatic renewal
This Agreement renews automatically for successive three (3) year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term. Supplier may increase prices on each renewal.

## 3. Fees and payment
Customer shall pay undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt. Late payments accrue interest at one percent (1%) per month.

## 4. Limitation of liability
Supplier's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the three (3) months preceding the claim. Customer's liability under this Agreement is unlimited.

## 5. Indemnification
Supplier shall indemnify Customer only for losses finally adjudicated by a court to arise from infringement of a third party's intellectual property. Supplier has no obligation to defend any claim.

## 6. Data protection
Supplier processes personal data in accordance with its privacy policy, which Supplier may update at any time without notice. The updated policy applies from the date it is published.

## 7. Non-solicitation
During the term and for twelve (12) months after it ends, Customer shall not solicit or hire any employee of Supplier who worked on the services.
